candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) on the inventory dependency, causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503 and order /v1/orders to fail with ReadTimeout, surfacing as 502s at gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics or logs admitted; root cause within redis (saturation vs network) not established.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts with DependencyUnavailable, inventory returning 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s; metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2.4s) and 502s. Topology confirms inventory->redis path. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
